name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-video-search
title: Google Video Search — FlashData
description: Google video search across websites, with titles, links and durations. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_videos access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Group Google video search results by website
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].videos. Group by the hostname of each link, retaining title, duration, source and original URL for a source inventory.
dev.flashdata.limits: This is Google video search, distinct from YouTube Search. Results contain search metadata, not media files.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
